mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS trend decline fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to the previous month signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past month indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST trend rise fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 275, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 275.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS above 145,000) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) indicates a labor market recovery phase that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS > 145000 and UNRATE > 5.5% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO trend rise fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.
